name: gen_dense_prime
description: folded dense prime p<=31 (any prime in class supported): 4h^2-FMA conjugate-pair fold, z-pass fused into the x-contraction with the z-combine folded straight into U/V (no stack round-trip), fully in-place L2-resident chain on a padded 31x31x32 state (64B-aligned, mask-free), register-tiled GEMM, vectorized any-L z-pass, zmm z-row fold, LAZY map fused into the next step's z-loads (s6 arithmetic, one vdivpd/8pts; only the last step's map materializes)
